business_summary: Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited operates as an owner and operator of luxury hotels in India. The company operates three hotels in Hyderabad, namely Taj Krishna; Taj Deccan; and Vivanta Begumpet; Taj Club House, and Taj Chandigarh, and also operates Taj Santacruz. The company provides accommodation services, including guest rooms and suites at its hotel properties. It also offers food and beverage services through multi-cuisine restaurants, specialty dining venues, and bars, including Encounters and Golden Dragon. In addition, the company provides banquet and event services, including banquet halls and conference room facilities for corporate events, social functions, and conferences. Further, it offers health club and spa facilities, laundry services, communication services, airport transfer services, and retail and shop space rentals at its hotel properties. The company also provides allied services, including membership fee programs and chamber memberships. It operates under the Taj brand name. It serves leisure travelers, business travelers, and corporate clients. Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited was formerly known as TAJ GVK Hotels & Resorts Limited and changed its name to Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited in September 2026. Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
